reason: A DeepSeek Harness bundle that distributes and installs a router-flash agent preset, then alters agent prompting and preset selection to guide DeepSeek V4 Flash workflows.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 分发并同步 router-flash agent preset，以调整 DeepSeek V4 Flash 的智能体提示与默认预设。
summaries.en: Distributes and synchronizes a router-flash agent preset for DeepSeek Harness to adjust prompting and the default preset used with DeepSeek V4 Flash.

capabilities: Installs and synchronizes an agent preset into ~/.dsh/.agent-presets/router-flash
Writes or overwrites bundled preset files during startup and upgrades
Changes agent prompting and model preset selection for DeepSeek V4 Flash
Uses the host filesystem with a danger-full-access policy as described in the README
